headline: Plus 32 billion UAH for teacher salaries: Terekhov demands increased education subvention in the 2027 State Budget
summary: Igor Terekhov, head of the Association of Frontline Cities and Communities, is demanding a higher education subvention in Ukraine's 2027 state budget. He discussed sector needs and frontline community proposals for the budget.
why: State budget allocations determine public spending on services such as education and set fiscal constraints for the government.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Плюс 32 млрд грн на зарплаты учителям: Терехов требует увеличить субвенцию на образование в Госбюджете на 2027 год
